lines.latin: Bruhanmumbai Mahanagar Palika (Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai)

notes: Blue BMC street plate hanging from a post, shot from below at an angle, Hindu Colony, Dadar, Mumbai. Ghost outlines of an older painted-over English name ('...ROAD', 'MUMBAI 400019') show faintly through the paint and are not labelled. The 'NO PARKING' board at lower left is a distractor. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

lines.text: THE HONG KONG AND SHANGHAI BANKING CORPORATION (HSBC)

notes: Stainless-steel UNESCO World Heritage (Victorian Gothic and Art Deco Ensembles of Mumbai) heritage plaque on the HSBC building, Fort, Mumbai, near Flora Fountain. Only the bold building-name heading is labelled; the top strapline, UNESCO block, 'ARCHITECTURAL STYLE : Art Deco', 'ARCHITECT : John A Ritchie, L Palfi', the history paragraph and the sponsor logos (UDRI, BMC seal, RPG Foundation, FORT) are not. Strong reflection darkens the right half. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:WHS signage of HSBC bank building.jpg
source_categories: Plaques of Victorian Gothic and Art Deco Ensembles of Mumbai

lines.latin: Sri Kanakadurga Pujastors (Sri Kanaka Durga Puja Stores)

notes: Hand-painted red-on-cream fascia over a closed shutter, Ameerpet, Hyderabad (shop attached to Sri Kanaka Durga Temple). A small framed picture hangs over the gap between దుర్గా and పూజా; word spacing on the painted board is irregular. Vertical side panels repeat the name: Telugu 'పూజా స్టోర్స్' at left and English 'PUJA STOR...' at right (cut off by the frame edge); these are not labelled as lines.
source_title: File:Sri Kanaka Durga Puja Stores shop attached with Sri Kanaka Durga Temple, Ameerpet.jpg
